ResourceRequired.description: Amount of resource $j$ required for experiment $i$

ElectricityProduced.description: Amount of electricity produced by experiment $i$

notes: The source variable type is continuous; we correct the variable type to integer.
The cutting plane (source variation `74_e`) is excluded because it is instance-specific.
Implicit non-negativity assumptions are added for every parameter.
The problem is NP-hard: it is a multi-dimensional integer knapsack problem. The number of resource constraints is part of the input, so it is strongly NP-hard.
